concerns.text: Phase 6 (Narrative Dynamics) and Phase 7 (Control Simulation) contain tasks (T040-T055) for User Stories 4 and 5. These USs and their requirements are absent from spec.md and plan.md. The 'Notes' section explicitly states these were 'REMOVED' as scope creep, yet the tasks remain in the file, creating a direct contradiction and unimplementable scope.

Task T008-SEQ implements sequential fMRIPrep execution to satisfy RAM constraints. This overrides spec.md FR-001 which mandates '8-core parallelization'. While the Plan authorizes this override, there is no task to formally update spec.md FR-001 to reflect the sequential execution reality, leaving the spec technically incorrect and untestable against the implementation.

Tasks T017 (error handling) and T018 (data hygiene/checksums) are marked as incomplete/missing implementation details in the file structure, yet they are required to satisfy spec.md FR-001 (checksum verification) and the Edge Cases (motion artifact logging). Without these tasks being fully defined and actionable, the spec requirements cannot be satisfied.

Tasks T012 (segmentation accuracy) and T023 (FDR correction) are flagged with '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM]' status. This indicates the implementation path for spec.md Success Criteria SC-001 (decoding significance) and SC-002 (pattern dissimilarity) is currently blocked or undefined, preventing verification of these critical success criteria.

The 'Notes' section claims Phase 6 and 7 were 'REMOVED', but the tasks (T040-T055) are still present in the document body. This is a stale tag/content issue where the text contradicts the file structure, confusing the implementer.
